title: FTP is not dead: when SFTP is overkill and FTPS is just right
lede: A Friday hotfix on a Magento 1 site, no SSH, no port 22 open, and the question gets suddenly real. SFTP is not always the answer, and FTPS is not the compromise it gets framed as.
hero_alt: Brass weighing scale on bone-coloured paper, one pan empty, the other holding an envelope sealed with red wax.
